variant_reviews.comparison: For r<=n apply the finite-dimensional symmetric-operator eigenbasis to AA^T on Euclidean n-space, take the first r basis vectors and multiply each by sqrt(n). For n>0 their Gram matrix divided by n equals I_r. Taking unit vectors without rescaling misses the normalization; using A^T A changes the ambient dimension and factor being estimated. The basis is chosen noncomputably and can vary within tied eigenspaces; its existence alone does not prove measurable dependence on A, sign uniqueness or uniqueness of a top-r subspace across a boundary tie. No finite-sample full rank of the true Lambda is imposed by this definition.

variant_reviews.comparison: Represent the two finite-dimensional column spaces by submodules and use starProjection as an endomorphism of Euclidean n-space, allowing P composed with (identity-Phat). Use the L2 operator norm rather than a default entrywise or Frobenius norm. A nontrivial orthogonal projection is idempotent but not an orthogonal matrix, so the printed P,Phat in O(n) is not validated by Matrix.orthogonalGroup. For equal-dimensional subspaces the stated norms correspond to the sine of the largest principal angle; if true Lambda is rank deficient relative to the estimated space the two displayed one-sided norms can differ. variant_reviews.comparison: Specialize mu_Lambda to uniform one-hot labels and Q0 to the outer product of their mean, with every matrix entry 1/k^2; this is not E Lambda Lambda^T=I_k/k. For each q>=0 compare sup over PSD k-by-k Q of F(q^2,Q) strictly against F(q^2,Q0), then take the infimum of the qualifying q. The PSD domain is nonempty, but finiteness of the inner real supremum still needs boundedness; the outer set is bounded below by zero but requires nonemptiness for real conditional-infimum guarantees, or an explicit extended-value convention. F was introduced only for s>0, so inclusion of q=0 needs an acknowledged extension, not an implicit totalized value. No existence at the threshold or conclusion for q equal to it follows from strict improvement and an infimum alone.
